description: Run the official rule set for the detected format (KoSIT for XRechnung/ZUGFeRD/Factur-X, OpenPeppol for Peppol BIS, FA(3) schema for KSeF, Porezna uprava HR-CIUS schematron for Croatian eRačun, Facturae XSD + calculation/NIF/DIR3 rules for Spain, LHDN SDK rules for MyInvois). Returns valid/invalid with every failed rule: id, severity, message, XPath.

content.description: Invoice XML (UBL, CII, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3)) as text

content_base64.description: A ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (or any invoice file) as base64, when the invoice is not plain XML

kosit.description: Run the full KoSIT schematron (default true). false = schema and core checks only, faster

name: validate_invoice
title: Validate e-invoice
